commands.command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
# Study the repeat-loop memoization in checker.py
# signature() drops NESTED writes of function-returning functions:
#   signature(Function(result,writes)) = (shape(result), writes)
#   shape() keeps only scalar kind-sets, dropping inner functions' `writes`.
# So in the fixed-point loop, memo[key] can collide for two function types
# that differ only in nested writes -> under-approximated writes survive the loop.
import inspect, checker
print(inspect.getsource(checker.Checker.block)[2600:3600])
EOF

cd /app && cat > witness.json <<'EOF'
{"cells":{"c":{"types":["int","text"],"value":"hi"}},
 "inputs":{},
 "body":[
  ["let","f",["fn",[],["fn",[],["lit",null]]]],
  ["repeat",["lit",2],[
    ["if",["is","c","int"],
      [["assign","f",["fn",[],["fn",[["set","c",["lit","oops"]]],["lit",null]]]]],
      [["assign","f",["fn",[],["fn",[],["lit",null]]]]]],
    ["set","c",["lit",0]]]],
  ["set","c",["lit",7]],
  ["eval",["call",["call",["var","f"]]]],
  ["if",["is","c","text"],
    [["eval",["add",["get","c"],["lit",1]]]],
    []]]}
EOF
python3 evaluate.py witness.json; echo "EXIT=$?"

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
from language import load, validate, MAX_NODES
from checker import check
from interpreter import run
text=open('witness.json').read()
p=load(text)
print("bytes:", len(text.encode()), "nodes:", validate(p), "(limit 512)")
print("checker accepts:", check(p))
r=run(p)
print("interpreter:", r['status'], "steps:", r['steps'], "|", r.get('message'))
EOF
python3 evaluate.py witness.json >/dev/null; echo "repeat run EXIT=$?"
ls -la /app

# Reed language

A program is a UTF-8 JSON object with exactly `cells`, `inputs`, and `body`.
Only JSON is read; submitted Python files and reported execution traces are not
part of the program. Duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite numbers are invalid.

```
{"cells":{"box":{"types":["int","text"],"value":0}},
 "inputs":{"flag":true,"count":2},
 "body":[["eval",["add",["get","box"],["lit",1]]]]}
```

Names match `[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,23}`. There are at most eight cells and eight
inputs, with disjoint names. Each cell declares a nonempty set of scalar kinds
and an initial value of one of those kinds. Kinds are `int`, `text`, `bool`, and
`unit`. Literals and inputs are signed 32-bit integers, strings of at most 1024
Unicode code points, booleans, or JSON null (`unit`
